Fetid Ooze is a type of Ooze creature and non-playable race found in Act Two.

Interactions

A deposit of three oozes lurks at the bottom of a charnel pit in the House of Healing Morgue. They hide alongside a Hollow Armour, ready to  Ambush the party, unless revealed by  See Invisibility. The creatures turn hostile and reveal themselves the moment a character touches the bottom floor of the pit.

Combat

The ooze's Fetid Aura inflicts Fetid Fumes to any character within 2 m (7 ft), dealing 1d6⁠⁠Acid at the start of each round.

Notes

  • Fetid Ooze lacks the ability Jump.
